candidates.change_summary: Return the zero address instead of the stored oracle address.
candidates.mutated_unit_code: function oracle() public view returns (IOracleProvider) { return IOracleProvider(address(0)); }

candidates.change_summary: Return a modified address (stored address plus one) instead of the stored oracle address.
candidates.mutated_unit_code: function oracle() public view returns (IOracleProvider) { return IOracleProvider(address(uint160(_oracle.read()) + 1)); }
